name: My Femboy Roommate: Special Weekend
source: You take your femboy roommate turned boyfriend, Robin, to a fancy resort for your one year anniversary. Explore and enjoy everything the high-end resort has to offer while bonding and getting closer to Robin. How will you make the most of this special weekend?
